description: List one list's items in list order with cursor pagination. Each item carries its name, item type, task status, priority, due date, section, position, description, and review status, plus the values it holds for the properties the list binds as columns. A fact item also carries its factDetailsStatus: visible or feature_unavailable. Visible evidential detail includes date and precision, evidence kind, medium, confidence, interpretation note, scoring (null until set) and its first source (document id, document name, locator; null when absent). Unavailable detail and first source are null.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
